automation_name: Autonomous Maintenance Request Triage & Vendor Coordination
automation_subtitle: A non-disruptive operational overlay that turns unstructured tenant messages into organized, manager-approved vendor actions.
known_company_context: Based on your portfolio of scattered-site residential units, managing 24/7 tenant maintenance requests across email, portal, and text typically consumes dozens of coordinator hours each week—creating a constant tension between after-hours burnout and the risk of delayed habitability emergencies.
problem_summary: Maintenance requests arrive undifferentiated around the clock. Coordinators spend hours deciphering rambling emails, re-keying details into work orders, chasing tenants for missing access/pet details, and assessing urgency manually—while true emergencies risk sitting unnoticed until morning.
desired_outcome_headline: Zero emergency maintenance reports sitting unread outside office hours, with 70%+ of routine triage, clarification, and dispatch preparation handled before human review.
next_step_desc: If this concept addresses a tangible bottleneck in your operation, we spend 15 minutes reviewing your current intake channels and PM software setup to confirm practical feasibility. Zero sales pitch, no commitment.
